title: Compare isolated app settings
task: Use bash bin/show-config.sh to generate three reports. Write its defaults to default.out with APP_MODE and LOG_LEVEL removed for that invocation. Write APP_MODE=preview and LOG_LEVEL=debug output to preview.out. Write APP_MODE=release and the default LOG_LEVEL output to release.out. Keep host config files untouched.
hints: Read the script and find both default expressions.
Use env -u for variables you want absent. Use assignments preceding bash for one-off settings.
For the release run set APP_MODE=release and unset LOG_LEVEL for that invocation. Compare the two lines in each report.

checks.label: The first execution uses both defaults
checks.feedback: Remove both variables from the command environment.

checks.label: The preview execution sees both overrides
checks.feedback: Set preview and debug on the same command line.

checks.label: The release execution keeps the default log level
checks.feedback: Set the mode and remove the inherited log-level setting for that run.

demo.explanation: env removes REGION from the environment of this invocation before launching Bash.
An assignment before a command gives it a one-run override.
